payload.title: Subscribe page and signup touchpoints
payload.description: Subscribe page (list choices, topic chips, success state, preview card, Inside every issue, sponsor banner, FAQ); header Subscribe button, in-article box, end-of-article panel, sticky bar after half the article (dismissible, remembered), exit-intent slide-in once per visitor, confirmation toast. With no signup endpoint configured, forms route to /subscribe/ and the page says signups are not open yet; it never fakes success.
